reviews.title: Awsome and well priced AIO cooler.
reviews.comment: It is an amazing value aio, with power enough to cool any modern cpu. I will say though the first one I bought died on me about 2 months in. So I got a replacement and now everything works great. I don't know if it was a quilty control issue or user error, but as of right now the cooler works great. It keeps my 14th gen i9 at 32° on ambient and 60°-70° with a meduim to heavly load.

reviews.title: Dead in 8 months
reviews.comment: Pump stopped working in less than 8 months. Next does not cross ship so I had to take the component out in order to send back before they would send a replacement.  As a critical PC component the PC can not be used until resolved and their answer was to send a fedex ground snail mail. So how long will the PC be down? No telling as it completely relies on the shipping and NZXT going through the component.  Im highly disappointed in their products as this should not fail in such a short period of time
reviews.author: JAMESB

reviews.title: A great AIO cooler
reviews.comment: NZXT makes such high quality products with such beautiful aesthetics, I have a few components by them for my build and the AIO might be the best one, it keeps my very hot 9850x3D very cool and the display looks amazing and it's very easy to customize.
